comments.author: Dana Whitfield
comments.body: Shipped in editor 3.12; docs snippet published on example.com/help/date-chips.

content.text: Shipped in editor 3.12; docs snippet published on example.com/help/date-chips.
Inserting dates in docs requires the date picker or typing a full ISO string. Writers want relative shortcuts while outlining schedules.

Slash commands: /date, /today, /tomorrow, /+3d, /-1w insert date chips with the resolved calendar day stored in UTC midnight of the workspace TZ, displayed in the viewer’s locale. Chips remain updateable via the existing date popover.
Complete when invalid offsets show inline errors, commands appear in the slash palette with examples, and collaborative peers see the same absolute day.
